name: create_table
description: Create a new table in the specified instance.

columnFamilies.description: Optional. The names of the column families to be created in the table. Example: `["cf1", "cf2"]`. The tool mapping will apply a default garbage collection policy (e.g., keeping only the latest version) to each column family.

instanceId.description: Required. The instance ID within the project where the table will be created (e.g., "my-instance").

projectId.description: Required. The project ID (e.g., "my-project"). If not known from the context, the Agent should attempt to get the current project ID from the gcloud config by running `gcloud config get-value project`. If the attempt fails, prompt the user for the project ID.

tableId.description: Required. The ID to be used when referring to the new table within its instance, e.g., just `mytable`.
